edits.old: Determine valid relationships before numbering, combine shared headings, and give every heading and subheading its own entry. For each complete source subject, compare its own wording with every returned heading using the parent check. An equal-meaning heading's own entry already represents the source subject; include it among the descendants of every more-general compatible heading, independently at every numbered occurrence even when surrounding branches differ. Placement elsewhere cannot repair a missing branch.
edits.new: Determine valid relationships before numbering, combine shared headings, and give every heading and subheading its own entry.
